findings.highlight: It’s already past one o’clock
findings.evidenceJa: 午前一時をとうに過ぎている
findings.governingReading: it is long past one in the morning
findings.explanation: The substantial lateness that frames Sakura’s vigil is weakened to merely after one.

findings.highlight: I put my hand over my mouth as I cough up blood
findings.evidenceJa: 咳き込む口に手を当てると、わずかに血が付いていた
findings.governingReading: when he covers his coughing mouth, a little blood is left on his hand
findings.explanation: mirror moon turns a small residue discovered after coughing into the more acute action of coughing up blood.

findings.highlight: My stomach still hurts from Assassin’s attack
findings.evidenceJa: アサシンに殴られた腹
findings.governingReading: the abdomen struck by Assassin still hurts
findings.explanation: The site of the blow is again moved from the abdominal wall to the stomach organ.

findings.highlight: I don’t know how badly wounded my stomach is
findings.evidenceJa: 腹部の損傷は判らない
findings.governingReading: he does not know the extent of the abdominal damage
findings.explanation: Uncertain internal abdominal injury becomes a graded wound to the stomach.

findings.highlight: The wounds that healed so quickly before
findings.evidenceJa: 以前ならすぐさま治っていた掠り傷
findings.governingReading: a graze that previously would have healed at once
findings.explanation: The specific minor injury used to measure his lost healing is generalized and pluralized.

findings.highlight: When I had my contract with Saber, wounds healed themselves
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと契約してから今まで、傷という傷は全てひとりでに治療されていた
findings.governingReading: from contracting with Saber until now, every injury without exception had treated itself
findings.explanation: The full temporal span and universality of Saber’s healing protection disappear.

findings.highlight: But that’s lost
findings.evidenceJa: それもなくなった
findings.governingReading: that protection too is gone
findings.explanation: The English leaves the lost mechanism as an unidiomatic, unclear object.

findings.highlight: I find Sakura waiting for me
findings.evidenceJa: 屋敷に入るなり、桜が廊下に立っていた
findings.governingReading: the moment he enters the house, Sakura is standing in the hallway
findings.explanation: The English presents Shirou’s later inference that Sakura waited as established fact before he tests it.

findings.highlight: the light was on
findings.evidenceJa: 玄関の明かりが点いてた
findings.governingReading: the entrance light was on
findings.explanation: The spatial clue supporting Shirou’s inference that Sakura stayed at the door is generalized.

findings.highlight: over three hours
findings.evidenceJa: 三時間弱
findings.governingReading: just under three hours
findings.explanation: The duration of Sakura’s possible vigil is reversed across the three-hour boundary.

findings.highlight: I’m surprised
findings.evidenceJa: 目が点になる
findings.governingReading: his eyes become dots
findings.explanation: A comic visual reaction to Sakura’s forcefulness becomes generic surprise.

findings.highlight: Sakura is really pushy right now
findings.evidenceJa: いつになく強引で、唐突だ
findings.governingReading: Sakura is unusually forceful and abrupt
findings.explanation: The departure from Sakura’s ordinary manner and the suddenness of the offer are reduced to a blunt personality judgment.

findings.highlight: she’s forcing herself to act this way
findings.evidenceJa: 桜がそんな風に気を遣うぐらい
findings.governingReading: Sakura is showing that degree of consideration for him
findings.explanation: Her active solicitude is reinterpreted as strained performance without support.

findings.highlight: my aching stomach
findings.evidenceJa: ズキン、と鈍く痛む腹
findings.governingReading: his abdomen throbbing with a dull stab of pain
findings.explanation: The pain’s location, dull quality, and sudden pulse are all flattened.

findings.highlight: I wince with pain, but lie on the cushion and bear it
findings.evidenceJa: 座布団に陣取った腰が跳ねる
findings.governingReading: his seated hips jump up from the cushion
findings.explanation: The involuntary bodily jolt is replaced by an invented act of lying down and enduring the treatment.

findings.highlight: I don’t want to interrupt
findings.evidenceJa: 口をはさむ余地がない
findings.governingReading: there is no opening in which he could intervene
findings.explanation: Sakura’s concentrated authority makes interruption impossible; the English turns it into Shirou’s preference.

findings.highlight: I threw up the tea
findings.evidenceJa: 不覚にも吐き出してしまった
findings.governingReading: he involuntarily spat the tea back out
findings.explanation: A reaction to abdominal pain is escalated into vomiting.

findings.highlight: I didn’t want Sakura to find out
findings.evidenceJa: 隠し通すつもりだった
findings.governingReading: he intended to conceal the injury completely
findings.explanation: A deliberate plan to keep the injury hidden becomes a general desire for secrecy.

findings.highlight: I had no choice but to tell her
findings.evidenceJa: むー、と拗ね顔で問い詰められた結果
findings.governingReading: after she questioned him with a pouty “muu” expression
findings.explanation: The comic mechanism by which Sakura forces the confession disappears.

findings.highlight: tell her how badly I was hurt
findings.evidenceJa: 実は怪我をしていると自白させられ
findings.governingReading: made to confess that he was in fact injured
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds disclosure of injury severity beyond the confession stated.

findings.highlight: you hurt your stomach
findings.evidenceJa: 怪我ってお腹ですか
findings.governingReading: the injury is to his abdomen or belly
findings.explanation: The body region is again anatomically narrowed to the stomach.

findings.highlight: I didn’t want to stop Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 頑張ってる桜を止めるのも悪いし
findings.governingReading: it would feel wrong to stop Sakura when she is trying so hard
findings.explanation: The reciprocal recognition of Sakura’s effort is reduced to Shirou’s preference.

findings.highlight: I did as I was told and let her treat me
findings.evidenceJa: シャツを脱いで、桜に背中を任せた
findings.governingReading: he removes his shirt and entrusts his back to Sakura
findings.explanation: The concrete intimacy and trust are replaced by generic obedience.

findings.highlight: gulping “I-I’m starting”
findings.evidenceJa: にらみ合いは何分か続いて、桜は「い、いきます」と喉を鳴らして手当てを始めてくれた
findings.governingReading: after several minutes of staring it down, Sakura gulps, says “I-I’m starting,” and begins treatment
findings.explanation: mirror moon prints the active sentence as fragmented prose, duplicates the spoken line, and leaves an extra malformed “gulping” variant on screen.

findings.highlight: my back feels much better
findings.evidenceJa: 背中の痛みは幾らか和らいでくれた
findings.governingReading: the pain in his back has eased somewhat
findings.explanation: The degree of improvement is overstated.

findings.highlight: I’m sorry I kept you up so late
findings.evidenceJa: こんな夜更けに起こしてすまなかった
findings.governingReading: he is sorry for waking her at such a late hour
findings.explanation: The apology is changed from having awakened Sakura to having prevented sleep continuously.

findings.highlight: the reality of it finally sinks in
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の『もしかしたら』が、完全に打ち消された
findings.governingReading: his final “perhaps” is completely extinguished
findings.explanation: The loss of Shirou’s last residual hope becomes generic psychological acceptance.

findings.highlight: It’s not like it’s a stupid question
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の疑問は当然だ
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s question is only natural
findings.explanation: A positive acknowledgment of Sakura’s reasonable inference becomes a defensive double negative with an insulting frame.

findings.highlight: Saber disappeared before I could even say goodbye
findings.evidenceJa: 別れを言う事も出来ず、セイバーはいなくなった
findings.governingReading: Saber disappeared without herself being able to say farewell
findings.explanation: The failure to say goodbye is reassigned from Saber to Shirou, weakening the mutual deprivation that prevents him from agreeing with Sakura.

findings.highlight: it’s not that I was helping Saber. Saber was helping me
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに付き合ってたんじゃなくて、俺がセイバーをつき合わせてた
findings.governingReading: he was not accompanying Saber; he was the one who made Saber accompany him
findings.explanation: The explicit reversal of who enlisted whom in a dangerous course becomes a looser exchange of assistance.

findings.highlight: My tension is gone now
findings.evidenceJa: 緊張も解れたんだろう
findings.governingReading: his tension has probably relaxed
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative explanation for sudden sleepiness becomes a stated completed condition.

findings.highlight: Drowsiness overtakes me
findings.evidenceJa: 体も心も今すぐ眠りに落ちたがっている
findings.governingReading: both his body and heart want to fall asleep immediately
findings.explanation: The divided bodily and emotional exhaustion becomes an accomplished physiological event.

findings.highlight: to prepare myself
findings.evidenceJa: 覚悟を決めようと
findings.governingReading: to settle his resolve
findings.explanation: Shirou’s deliberate acceptance of the coming fight is weakened to unspecified preparation.

findings.highlight: It hurts just to think about it
findings.evidenceJa: 胸が軋む
findings.governingReading: his chest creaks when he recalls it
findings.explanation: The physicalized strain of memory is reduced to generic hurt.

findings.highlight: my mind is about to lose against anger or fear
findings.evidenceJa: 怒りとも恐れともつかない焦燥に、心が折れそうになる
findings.governingReading: under an agitation he cannot tell is anger or fear, his heart feels close to breaking
findings.explanation: The English makes anger and fear opponents defeating his mind, losing both their ambiguity and the breaking-point image.

findings.highlight: I know with certainty
findings.evidenceJa: 確信めいたものがある
findings.governingReading: he has something resembling conviction, despite not seeing it
findings.explanation: A strong but explicitly qualified inference about Saber’s defeat is promoted into certain knowledge.

findings.highlight: I’ll have to deal with Matou Zouken and Assassin
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐臓硯やアサシンとも争わなければならない
findings.governingReading: he must also fight or contend with Matou Zouken and Assassin
findings.explanation: The lethal additional conflicts are euphemized as “deal with.”

findings.highlight: Zouken will continue to haunt me
findings.evidenceJa: 臓硯は必ず現れる
findings.governingReading: Zouken will certainly appear
findings.explanation: A concrete prediction based on continued pursuit becomes ongoing supernatural or psychological haunting.

findings.highlight: the only weapon I have is magic as a half-ass magus
findings.evidenceJa: 武器になるのは半人前の魔術だけだ
findings.governingReading: his only weapon is his half-fledged magecraft
findings.explanation: The inadequacy modifies Shirou’s magecraft in Japanese; mirror moon attaches a vulgar insult to Shirou as a person and changes magecraft to magic.

findings.highlight: become a superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になる
findings.governingReading: become a champion or ally of justice
findings.explanation: The work’s central ethical formulation is replaced with a genre label carrying different motives and expectations.

findings.highlight: My only option is to stop the war so such a disaster will not occur again
findings.evidenceJa: 俺に許された事は、二度とあんな惨状を繰り返させないよう、戦いを止める事だけ
findings.governingReading: the only thing he permits himself is stopping the conflict so that devastation like that never recurs
findings.explanation: The self-denying permission structure of Shirou’s ideal becomes ordinary strategic constraint.

findings.highlight: this will be the only night that I’ll tremble in fear
findings.evidenceJa: 震えるのはこの夜だけ
findings.governingReading: he must let this be the only night he trembles
findings.explanation: mirror moon resolves the source’s recently ambiguous anger-or-fear agitation specifically as fear.

findings.highlight: I have to act strong
findings.evidenceJa: 強い自分になっていなくちゃいけない
findings.governingReading: he must have become a stronger self
findings.explanation: Required inner transformation is reduced to outward performance.

findings.highlight: so the girl who disappeared can be proud of me
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女に胸を張れるよう
findings.governingReading: so he can hold his head high before the girl who disappeared
findings.explanation: Shirou’s ability to face Saber’s memory by his own standard becomes Saber granting him approval.
